correctness.rationale: The one-probe variance is exactly twice the off-diagonal Frobenius energy. For fixed eigenvalues, constant diagonal minimizes diagonal square energy and is attainable by Schur--Horn, yielding the sharp orientation reduction. Each spectral coordinate has an interior minimum, so a maximum occurs at endpoint eigenvalues. The resulting one-parameter integer objective has derivative proportional to n-(kappa+1)r, proving the two-candidate floor/ceiling law. Averaging independent probes divides variance by m. Exact rational replay checks the algebra and an equality witness.
